diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.name: interaction-wake-idempotency-r3-20261029
diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.cause: A fabricated interaction key reached the issue-execution deferral branch before the locked idempotency guard, which attempted to persist a deferred receipt.
diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.resolution: Validate the canonical interaction source before admission/deferral writes, while retaining the locked recheck before replay.

diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.name: interaction-wake-idempotency-r4-20261029
diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.cause: The test payload omitted mutation=interaction, so normalizeInteractionContinuationWakeContext correctly cleared its untrusted interaction fields; the malformed generic wake took the deferral path.
diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.resolution: The final test now carries the canonical interaction mutation marker and verifies the fabricated ID is refused by source validation.

diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.name: rejected-interaction-idempotency-r1-20261029
diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.cause: A rejected wake_assignee continuation with an existing active receipt bypassed both interaction idempotency guards and attempted a second queue insert. PostgreSQL raised 23505 on agent_wakeup_requests_question_response_delivery_idempotency_uq for interaction:<id>:rejected.
diagnostics_not_counted_as_passes.resolution: Include rejected in preflight and locked canonical wake receipt handling. Admit rejected wake_assignee continuations and actual rejected plan confirmations; keep ordinary wake_assignee_on_accept rejection denied.

chat_retry_root_cause: Both immediate postcommit dispatch attempts correctly observed row-lock contention and persisted a future retryAt; the test then invoked the processor before that retry was due. Deferring scheduling in this ownership test isolates the concurrent route commits and paired background processors without changing service behavior or weakening the one-receipt assertion.
rejected_wake_root_cause: The database partial unique index covers active interaction:<id>:<status> receipts for rejected responses too; omitting rejected from heartbeat guards turned intended replay into a 23505 insert error.
